# Butler v0.1.0

Since v0.0.21, Butler has added:

- A native Rust Butler Agent with versioned installs, updates, rollback and
  uninstall. Linux Agent archives are available for x64 and ARM64, with a
  one-line installer. Linux App packaging now covers DEB builds for Ubuntu and
  Debian (x64 and ARM64) and an Arch x64 package.
- `npx @hexpygames/butler install` for installing the standalone Agent.
- A Windows desktop source preview; there is no downloadable Windows installer
  yet.
- Daily, weekday and weekly schedules at a local time, with localized summaries
  and next-run times. Schedules are shared across the App, API, CLI and chat tools.
- Faster usage, update and session reads, plus substantially fewer idle SSD
  writes from transcript projection.
- Removal of Telegram support; the Butler App is the supported connection.
